---
name: Theme proposal
about: Propose a new community theme
labels: enhancement
---

## Theme idea

Name and mood/palette family (for example: "Solarized-style light theme").

## Base palette

`light` or `dark` (see [docs/theme-spec.md](../docs/theme-spec.md)).

## Rough palette

Primary colors if you already have them; a description is fine otherwise.

## Anything beyond tokens?

If the theme needs more than alias-token overrides (which are the supported surface), describe it — non-token changes are out of scope for this repository.
